title: Amasing experience
text: My husband and I recently visited Barcelona. We booked a private tour with Christian and it was the best choice ever made! His knowledge on history is unbelievable! His love for the city is contagious! We loved every minute of it! Highly recommended! Next time we are in Barcelona will book more tours with Christian!
author: AnthiBog

title: Highly recommended
text: Barcelona with a private guide! It was just great. So much seen, walked, amazed and learned. I was amazed at how much there was to explore, away from the usual tourist streams. Christian showed us so many little things and hidden corners that made the city even more lovable. Thank you also for the culinary tips. We tested everything on the same day and felt megacrass for it!!! Daaaaannnkke.
author: K7387YGwilmav

title: Barcelona up close!
text: We had a great private tour of El Born and Brera. With many hidden places we got a competent overview... From historical contexts to insights into the special architecture to excellent recommendations in culinary terms, we have lacked nothing. Thank you very much Christian, for the beautiful experience!
author: ingat580

title: Individual and impressive city tour – highly recommended!
text: We had a private city tour for two and were absolutely delighted! The tour was informative, exciting and at the same time pleasantly relaxed. We particularly loved how individual our interests were addressed. My walking disability was also taken into account without any problems – the pace and route were adjusted accordingly, so I felt comfortable at all times. A great experience that really enriched our Barcelona stay. Thank you for that!
author: jensmH7188UA

title: Outstanding tour
text:
Christians guided tour took us to hidden places we would have never seen exploring the city on our own. His explanations were perfect and absolutely interesting. We enjoyed having a short break on one of the quiet wonderful plazas, drinking a beer and talking about this and that. In the evening we had dinner in one of the restaurants, Christian recommended, it was great. 
Many thanks for this wonderful experience.
author: stephaniebX1657II

title: A tour that is worth it!!
text:
We went on the tour with Christian through the winding alleys of the old town.
It was more like a walk with a friend - great conversations, lots of explanations and stories. The time flew by. Thank you very much for letting us experience Barcelona and its alleys like this, we will remember it.
author: Explore12771873279

title: Great tour through the city center of Barcelona
text: Michael was very knowledgeable and gave us a wonderful insight and overview of the history and stories of Barcelona. It was a very entertaining and interesting tour.
author: annettegT7262BH

title: In Depth Understanding
text: Christian provided an unique and interesting recounting of the less well-known neighborhoods of Barcelona.  It was wonderful to immerse ourselves in the areas where locals live and work and understand the history of the city.
author: Linda_G

title: Excellent
text: It was great learning the history and architecture of the city. As well as some travel tips as well.
author: Christopher_C

title: Wonderfully personal and dedicated!
text: Barcelona a little different and very personal inquiry - Christian and Michael are just right for it. Those who, like us, are really curious about history, architecture, the (hidden) beauty of such a wonderful old town, way of life, but also local politics and lively discussions, will simply love the tours. Highly recommended!
author: Murmeltier56
